title: Elite Dangerous Buttkicker Pattern File (schema v2)
description: The one canonical description of a pattern pack. It describes the shape the runtime actually deserializes (EDButtkicker.Services.PatternFile / EDButtkicker.Models.HapticPattern) and the bounds the runtime actually enforces (EDButtkicker.Services.PatternSchemaValidator). A file that this schema accepts is a file the engine will index and play; anything it rejects is refused at load time with a field-by-field diagnostic. Keep the two in step - if a rule changes here, change it in PatternSchemaValidator, and the other way round. Schema versioning and the v1 -> v2 migration are documented in docs/pattern-pack-schema-versioning.md and implemented in EDButtkicker.Services.PatternSchemaVersion / PatternPackMigrator.

schemaVersion.description: Revision of this schema the file targets, as 'major' or 'major.minor'. Optional: a file that omits it is read as v1, because the field was added after the first packs shipped. The major number is the migration boundary - this build reads v1 (migrated in memory on load, never rewritten on disk) and v2 (read as written), and refuses anything newer by name. The minor number marks additions within a major: a build reads every minor at or below its own, so v2.0 is the highest this build accepts. v1 differs from v2 only in the layer field names: see the 'intensity' and 'delay' properties of patternLayer.

name.description: Name of the pattern pack (required: the pack is identified by it)

tags.description: Tags for categorization (e.g., combat, exploration, cinematic)

ships.description: Ship patterns keyed by ship type (e.g., anaconda, sidewinder). At least one ship is required.

events.description: Event patterns keyed by event name (e.g., FSDJump, Docked). May be empty - a ship with no events is a placeholder, not an error.

pattern.description: Base pattern type (EDButtkicker.Models.PatternType). An unknown value is refused while the file is being parsed.

frequency.description: Base frequency in Hz. Below 10Hz the transducer moves nothing a body feels; above 100Hz it is audible buzz.

intensity.description: Base intensity percentage. 0 is silence, which is never what an event pattern means.

duration.description: Pattern duration in milliseconds (RequestLimits.MaxPatternDurationMs caps the top end)

fadeIn.description: Fade in duration in milliseconds. fadeIn + fadeOut must not exceed duration, or the envelope has no sustain section left.

fadeOut.description: Fade out duration in milliseconds. fadeIn + fadeOut must not exceed duration.

intensityFromDamage.description: Scale intensity based on hull damage

minIntensity.description: Minimum intensity for damage scaling; must not exceed maxIntensity

intensityCurve.description: Intensity curve type (EDButtkicker.Models.IntensityCurve). Custom requires at least two customCurvePoints.

customCurvePoints.description: Custom curve points for the Custom intensity curve, ordered by ascending time

layers.description: Layers for MultiLayer and Sequence patterns

conditions.description: Conditional logic, as a property-name -> expected-value map (runtime: Dictionary<string, object>), e.g. { "health_below": 0.5 }. Not an array of comparison objects.

chainedPatterns.description: Names of patterns to play after this one (runtime: List<string>). Patterns are chained by reference, not embedded.

enableVoiceAnnouncement.description: Enable voice announcement for this pattern

enableAudioCue.description: Play an audio cue alongside the pattern

audioCueFile.description: Path to the audio cue file

amplitude.description: Layer amplitude, 0-1. The v2 name for this field.

intensity.description: The v1 name for `amplitude`. A pack that declares schemaVersion 1 (or declares none) is migrated to `amplitude` in memory when it loads; the file on disk is never rewritten. Do not use in a pack that declares v2.

startTime.description: Milliseconds from the pattern start before this layer begins. Must be inside the pattern duration, or the layer is never heard. The v2 name for this field.

delay.description: The v1 name for `startTime`, migrated in memory exactly as `intensity` is. Do not use in a pack that declares v2.

duration.description: Layer duration in milliseconds; 0 means run to the end of the pattern

fadeIn.description: Layer fade in, milliseconds. fadeIn + fadeOut must fit inside the layer's span.

curve.description: Intensity curve applied to this layer

time.description: Time point as a fraction of the duration (0-1)

intensity.description: Intensity at that time point, as a fraction of the pattern intensity (0-1)
